required_tasks: Explicit authorized original Chinese intent/context and acceptable outputs
Human-produced full key trace including apostrophes, edits, cancel, OOV and supported input modes
Two independent reviewers, disagreement record and a distinct adjudicator
Representative pre-registered groups; unavailable capabilities remain in denominators
Do not derive answers from the Cloudleaf lexicon or old 41/83 diagnostic seeds
required_provenance: Original artifact SHA and fixed source/revision/author/permission scope
Global source lineage and semantic near-duplicate group across mirrors and republications
Canonical source unit IDs and one common preprocessing/normalization protocol SHA
Per-task consent and privacy review; no private input history collected by default
release_blockers: No actual annotation license/consent and frozen source artifact
No independent reviewers, adjudicator, custodian or sealed answers
No actual global lineage or semantic duplicate audit
No accepted representative language-quality or production resource evidence
